career_ladder.note: Indian Coast Guard Navik (Domestic Branch - Cook & Steward) is an enlisted maritime service cadre. Navik (DB) commences at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3 and progresses through subordinate and warrant officer ranks up to Pradhan Adhikari (Level 8).

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Navik (DB) in the Indian Coast Guard is conducted through Coast Guard Enrolled Personnel Test (CGEPT) across four stages. Stage-I is a Computer Based Written Examination (Section I: 60 questions, 60 marks, 45 minutes; Maths 20, Science 10, English 15, Reasoning 10, GK 5; no negative marking; minimum pass mark is 30 for UR/EWS/OBC and 27 for SC/ST). Stage-II involves the Assessment & Adaptability Test, Physical Fitness Test (1.6 km run in 7 minutes, 20 squat ups, 10 push-ups), and initial document verification. Stage-III is Document Verification and Final Medicals at INS Chilka. Stage-IV is training induction and final document scrutiny.

financial_package.note: Navik (Domestic Branch) in the Indian Coast Guard is placed in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3 (entry basic ₹21,700 to ₹69,100). In addition to basic pay, personnel receive Dearness Allowance, Dearness Allowance on Ration, free clothing, free medical facilities, and family accommodation.
financial_package.pay_source_label: ICG CGEPT Advertisement — Pay Level 3 for Navik (DB)
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹21,700 + 58% DA (₹12,586) + HRA/ration allowance + sea-duty / station allowance where applicable yields gross ~₹38,000 to ~₹46,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and standard deductions.
official_perks: Free ration and clothing according to existing government scales
Free medical treatment for self and family including dependents in Coast Guard / Armed Forces hospitals
Government accommodation for self and family on nominal licence fee where available, or central HRA
CSD Canteen amenities across Coast Guard and defence stations
45 days Earned Leave and 8 days Casual Leave per year with Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
